summary: This perek tells where each korban is shechted and eaten. The bull and goat of Yom Kippur are shechted in the north, and their blood is sprinkled in the Kodesh HaKodashim, on the paroches, and on the golden mizbeach.

chunks.en: Where is the place of the korbanos?
chunks.st: What is the location of the slaughtering and consumption of offerings?

chunks.en: The holiest korbanos are shechted in the north,
chunks.st: The principle is that with regard to offerings of the most sacred order, their slaughter is in the north of the Temple courtyard. Specifically,

words.note: The north side of the courtyard of the Beis HaMikdash.

chunks.en: The bull and the goat of the day
chunks.st: with regard to the bull and the goat of Yom Kippur,

chunks.en: of Yom Kippur are shechted in the north,
chunks.st: their slaughter is in the north

chunks.en: and their blood is caught in a holy vessel in the north,
chunks.st: and the collection of their blood in a service vessel is in the north,

words.note: A holy vessel used for the avodah.

chunks.he: וְדָמָן טָעוּן הַזָּיָה עַל בֵּין הַבַּדִּים
chunks.en: and their blood must be sprinkled between the poles
chunks.st: and their blood requires sprinkling between the staves of the Ark in the Holy of Holies,

words.note: The poles of the Aron in the Kodesh HaKodashim.

chunks.en: and on the paroches and on the golden mizbeach.
chunks.st: and upon the Curtain separating the Sanctuary and Holy of Holies, and on the golden altar. Concerning all those sprinklings,

words.note: The curtain in front of the Kodesh HaKodashim.

chunks.en: Each one of these puttings is a must.
chunks.st: failure to perform even one placement of their blood disqualifies the offering.

words.note: Without it the korban does not work.

chunks.en: The leftover blood he would pour on
chunks.st: As to the remainder of the blood, which is left after those sprinklings, a priest would pour

chunks.en: the western base of the outer mizbeach.
chunks.st: it onto the western base of the external altar.

chunks.en: If he did not put it there,
chunks.st: But if he did not place the remainder of the blood on the western base,

chunks.en: it does not hold it back.
chunks.st: it does not disqualify the offering.

summary: The bulls and goats that are burned are shechted in the north, and their blood is sprinkled on the paroches and the golden mizbeach. Afterwards they are burned outside the city, in the place of the ashes.

chunks.he: פָּרִים הַנִּשְׂרָפִים וּשְׂעִירִים הַנִּשְׂרָפִים שְׁחִיטָתָן בַּצָּפוֹן,
chunks.en: The bulls that are burned and the goats that are burned are shechted in the north,
chunks.st: With regard to bulls that are burned and goats that are burned, their slaughter is in the north of the Temple courtyard,

chunks.en: and their blood is caught in a holy vessel in the north,
chunks.st: and the collection of their blood in a service vessel is in the north,

chunks.en: and their blood must be sprinkled on
chunks.st: and their blood requires sprinkling

chunks.en: the paroches and on the golden mizbeach.
chunks.st: upon the Curtain separating the Sanctuary and Holy of Holies, and upon the golden altar,

chunks.en: Each one of these puttings is a must.
chunks.st: and failure to perform even one placement of their blood disqualifies the offering.

chunks.en: The leftover blood he would pour on
chunks.st: As for the remainder of the blood that is left after those sprinklings, a priest would pour

chunks.en: the western base of the outer mizbeach.
chunks.st: it onto the western base of the external altar,

chunks.en: If he did not put it there,
chunks.st: but if he did not pour

chunks.en: it does not hold it back.
chunks.st: the remainder it does not disqualify the offering.

chunks.en: Both these and those are burned in the place of the ashes.
chunks.st: These, the bull and the goat of Yom Kippur, and those, the bulls and the goats that are burned, are then burned in the place of the ashes,
chunks.stMore: a place outside of Jerusalem where the priests would bring the ashes from the altar.

words.note: A place outside Yerushalayim where the ashes of the mizbeach were brought.

summary: The goats brought as a chatas for the whole Jewish people on Rosh Chodesh and Yom Tov are shechted in the north. Their blood is put on the four corners of the mizbeach, and male Kohanim eat them in the courtyard until midnight.

chunks.en: The chatas korbanos of the community and of one person:
chunks.st: These are the halakhot of the communal and the individual sin offerings.

chunks.en: These are the chatas korbanos of the community:
chunks.st: These are the communal sin offerings:

chunks.en: the goats of Rosh Chodesh and of the Yamim Tovim.
chunks.st: Goats of the New Moon and of the Festivals.

chunks.en: They are shechted in the north,
chunks.st: Their slaughter is in the north of the Temple courtyard,

chunks.en: and their blood is caught in a holy vessel in the north,
chunks.st: and the collection of their blood in a service vessel is in the north,

chunks.en: and their blood needs four puttings
chunks.st: and their blood requires four placements

chunks.en: on the four corners.
chunks.st: on the four corners of the altar.

words.note: The four corners of the mizbeach.

chunks.en: How? He went up the ramp and turned to the ledge,
chunks.st: How did the priest do so? He ascended the ramp of the altar and turned right to the surrounding ledge and he continued east,

words.note: A narrow walkway around the mizbeach.

chunks.en: and came to the southeast corner,
chunks.st: and he came to the southeast corner

chunks.en: then the northeast,
chunks.st: and sprinkled the blood of the sin offering there and then to the northeast corner and sprinkled the blood there,

chunks.en: then the northwest,
chunks.st: and then to the northwest corner and sprinkled the blood there,

chunks.en: then the southwest.
chunks.st: and the southwest
chunks.stMore: corner, where he performed the fourth sprinkling and descended from the altar.

chunks.en: The leftover blood he would pour
chunks.st: He would pour the remainder of the blood

chunks.en: on the southern base.
chunks.st: on the southern base of the altar.

chunks.he: וְנֶאֱכָלִין לִפְנִים מִן הַקְּלָעִים לְזִכְרֵי כְהֻנָּה
chunks.en: And they are eaten inside the curtains by male Kohanim,
chunks.st: And the meat portions of the offering are eaten within the curtains, i.e., in the Temple courtyard, by the males of the priesthood.

words.note: Inside the courtyard of the Beis HaMikdash.

chunks.he: בְּכָל מַאֲכָל לְיוֹם וָלַיְלָה עַד חֲצוֹת:
chunks.en: cooked any way, for a day and a night, until midnight.
chunks.st: And they are eaten prepared in any form of food preparation, on the day the offering is sacrificed and during the night that follows, until midnight.

summary: The olah is one of the holiest korbanos. It is shechted in the north, its blood is put on the mizbeach twice so it reaches all four sides, and it is skinned, cut up, and burned whole.

chunks.en: The olah is one of the holiest korbanos.
chunks.st: The burnt offering is an offering of the most sacred order.

chunks.en: It is shechted in the north,
chunks.st: Its slaughter is in the north

chunks.en: and its blood is caught in a holy vessel in the north,
chunks.st: of the Temple courtyard and the collection of its blood in a service vessel is in the north,

chunks.he: וְדָמָהּ טָעוּן שְׁתֵּי מַתָּנוֹת שֶׁהֵן אַרְבַּע,
chunks.en: and its blood needs two puttings that are four,
chunks.st: and its blood requires two placements that are four,

words.note: Put on two opposite corners so it reaches all four sides.

chunks.en: and it needs skinning, cutting up, and to be burned whole on the fire.
chunks.st: and it requires flaying of its carcass and the cutting of the sacrificial animal into pieces, and it is consumed in its entirety, with the exception of its hide, by the fire of the altar.

summary: The shelamim of the community and the different kinds of asham are shechted in the north. Male Kohanim eat them in the courtyard, cooked any way, until midnight.

chunks.en: The shelamim of the community, and the asham korbanos.
chunks.st: These are the halakhot of communal peace offerings and guilt offerings.

chunks.en: These are the asham korbanos:
chunks.st: These are guilt offerings:

chunks.en: the asham for stealing,
chunks.st: The guilt offering for robbery,
chunks.stMore: brought by one from whom another demanded payment of a debt and he denied it and took a false oath (see Leviticus 5:20–26);

words.note: Brought by one who kept money that was not his and swore falsely.

chunks.en: the asham for using holy things,
chunks.st: the guilt offering for unwitting misuse of consecrated property (see Leviticus 5:14–16);

words.note: Using something that belongs to Hashem by mistake.

chunks.en: the asham of the shifchah charufah,
chunks.st: the guilt offering of an espoused maidservant,
chunks.stMore: brought by one who engaged in sexual intercourse with a Canaanite maidservant betrothed to a Hebrew slave (see Leviticus 19:20–22);

words.note: A korban brought for a certain forbidden relationship.

chunks.en: the asham of a nazir,
chunks.st: the guilt offering of a nazirite
chunks.stMore: who became impure via contact with a corpse (see Numbers 6:12);

words.note: Someone who promised not to drink wine or cut his hair for a time.

chunks.en: the asham of a metzora,
chunks.st: the guilt offering of a leper, brought for his purification (see Leviticus 14:12);

chunks.en: and the asham talui.
chunks.st: and the provisional guilt offering,
chunks.stMore: brought by one who is uncertain as to whether he committed a sin that requires a sin offering (see Leviticus 5:17–18). Concerning all of these,

words.note: Brought when a person is not sure if he did a sin.

chunks.en: They are shechted in the north,
chunks.st: their slaughter is in the north

chunks.en: and their blood is caught in a holy vessel in the north,
chunks.st: of the Temple courtyard and collection of their blood in a service vessel is in the north,

chunks.he: וְדָמָן טָעוּן שְׁתֵּי מַתָּנוֹת שֶׁהֵן אַרְבַּע,
chunks.en: and their blood needs two puttings that are four,
chunks.st: and their blood requires two placements that are four.

chunks.he: וְנֶאֱכָלִין לִפְנִים מִן הַקְּלָעִים לְזִכְרֵי כְהֻנָּה
chunks.en: And they are eaten inside the curtains by male Kohanim,
chunks.st: And the meat portions of the offering are eaten within the curtains, i.e., in the Temple courtyard, by male priests.

chunks.he: בְּכָל מַאֲכָל לְיוֹם וָלַיְלָה עַד חֲצוֹת:
chunks.en: cooked any way, for a day and a night, until midnight.
chunks.st: And they are eaten prepared in any manner of food preparation, on the day the offering was sacrificed and during the night that follows, until midnight.

summary: The todah and the nazir's ram are less holy korbanos. They may be shechted anywhere in the courtyard and eaten by anyone in all of Yerushalayim until midnight. The Kohen's portion may be eaten by his family too.

chunks.en: The todah and the ram of a nazir
chunks.st: The thanks offering and nazirite’s ram

words.note: A korban to thank Hashem after being saved.

chunks.en: are less holy korbanos.
chunks.st: are offerings of lesser sanctity.

chunks.en: They are shechted anywhere in the courtyard,
chunks.st: Their slaughter is anywhere in the Temple courtyard,

chunks.he: וְדָמָן טָעוּן שְׁתֵּי מַתָּנוֹת שֶׁהֵן אַרְבַּע,
chunks.en: and their blood needs two puttings that are four,
chunks.st: and their blood requires two placements that are four,

chunks.en: and they are eaten in the whole city by anyone,
chunks.st: and they are eaten throughout the city of Jerusalem, by every person, i.e., any ritually pure Jew,

chunks.en: cooked any way,
chunks.st: prepared in any manner of food preparation,

chunks.en: for a day and a night, until midnight.
chunks.st: on the day the offering was sacrificed and during the night that follows, until midnight.

chunks.en: The part taken off from them is like them,
chunks.st: The status of the portion that is separated from them and given to the priests is similar to theirs;

words.note: The portion given to the Kohen.

chunks.en: except that the part taken off is eaten by the Kohanim,
chunks.st: but the portion that is separated is eaten by the priests,

chunks.en: their wives, their children, and their servants.
chunks.st: by their wives, and by their children, and by their slaves.

summary: Shelamim are less holy korbanos. They may be shechted anywhere in the courtyard and eaten by anyone in all of Yerushalayim, for two days and one night.

summary: The bechor, maaser and korban Pesach need only one putting of blood. The bechor is eaten by Kohanim and maaser by anyone, for two days. The korban Pesach is eaten only at night, until midnight, by those signed up for it, and only roasted.

chunks.en: The bechor, the maaser, and the korban Pesach
chunks.st: The firstborn offering, the animal tithe offering, and the Paschal offering

chunks.st: Their slaughter is anywhere in the Temple courtyard,

chunks.en: and their blood needs one putting,
chunks.st: and their blood requires one placement,

chunks.en: as long as he puts it over the base.
chunks.st: provided that the priest places it so that the blood goes on the base of the altar.
